summary: The visible 'Cancel' control is a silent no-op once the machine is in WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, with no way to voluntarily leave that state short of re-tapping the tag.
claim: The visible 'Cancel' control is a silent no-op once the machine is in WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, with no way to voluntarily leave that state short of re-tapping the tag.

evidence.source: WriteStateMachine.cancel() (WriteStateMachine.kt): `if(phase==WRITING||VERIFYING||WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN){ if(phase!=WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN) writeInterrupted(...) } else {...=CANCELLED...}` — when phase is already WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, neither branch fires, so state is unchanged. NfcPanel (MainActivity.kt) renders `TextButton(onClick=nfc::cancel){Text("Cancel")}` whenever `phase != VERIFIED`, which includes WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

suggested_remediation: Hide/relabel the Cancel button while WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (e.g. show only re-tap guidance), or give it a real, clearly-labeled effect (e.g. explicitly abandon the journaled write and return to DRAFT with an explicit warning that the tag's true state is still unverified).
suggested_validation: From WRITE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, tap Cancel and confirm either the control is absent or the state/detail visibly changes; currently neither occurs.
